messages.text:
BL-831 — Bubble Pipeline page — the in-flight agent x ticket grid as a remote HTML page, with a blurb per ticket on the main view and a tap-through detail sheet carrying the spec and its Gherkin
What it solves: ## e2e procedure for QA
Approval context: The four specifier calls above (blurb source, detail sheet content, horizontal scroll, pager order) are all amendable and none is expensive to reverse.
The one with a real trade-off is the detail sheet: serving a ticket's spec body and its feature text to the phone means the bridge reads backlog YA…
BL-831 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-831" (or "reject BL-831 <reason>") to act.
